versions.changelog:
Initial release of jewelry-designer

- Generate hand-drawn jewelry design sheets, multiview sketches, and interactive 3D jewelry viewers from text prompts and reference images.
- Supports a wide variety of customizable jewelry types, including bracelets, rings, necklaces, earrings, body chains, pet collars, and more.
- Offers workflow from ideation and sketching to 3D model preview and manufacturing on demand.
- Integrates with the OneKey Agent Gateway for secure API access.
- Includes example prompts and quick start instructions for users.
